_comment: A capability declared the way a modpack author declares one: a .json file beside the pack's scenes, no build tool anywhere. It rides through the same provisioning as pack.js and lands in config/stagewright/capabilities/. The subject is worlddriver itself because this file has to be satisfiable in the runtime it runs in — the built-in descriptors StageWright ships (mekanism, ae2, create...) prove the OTHER half here, since none of those mods is installed and every one of them must report itself registered-but-absent.
name: pack:driver
absent: this descriptor names worlddriver, which is the mod whose own suite it ships in — absent here means the mod list never arrived
